purpose: Field registry for the Comparative Analysis Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name only.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates cell-type DE, niche DE, spatial pattern comparison, pathology scoring, phenotype linking, and representation-learning routes.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes expression-only, cell-type/reference-assisted, niche-aware, cross-sample, bulk-linked, and registered-image comparison routes.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Comparative Analysis.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the comparative-analysis role; do not foreground unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps broad methods scoped to comparative spatial transcriptomics method selection.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as DE genes, niche-differential genes, pathology scores, feature links, motifs, or statistical maps.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates methods that output gene-level tests from methods that output patterns, scores, motifs, or linked phenotype features.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate after task fit.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial scale, high resolution, many samples, or registration complexity.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps decide whether large cohorts, high-resolution assays, or registration-heavy datasets need extra scrutiny.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code/documentation source is confirmed.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes method-paper evidence from benchmark-supported or mixed evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to two concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, scale, and risk fields as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps uncertainty and evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Comparison Target
fields.definition: Primary comparative target addressed by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value representing the dominant target.
fields.topic_relevance: This is the main branch-local selector for Comparative Analysis.

fields.name: Comparison Design
fields.definition: Coarse study-design structure expected by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value; do not imply adequacy of the user's design.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates simple condition tests from niche, cohort, disease-control, bulk-linked, and registration-based comparisons.

fields.name: Spatial Context Use
fields.definition: Dominant way spatial structure enters the comparison.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value representing the dominant spatial signal use.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes cell-type, niche, coordinate, correlation, motif, pathology-score, TME, and registered-image routes.

fields.name: External Reference / Cohort Signal
fields.definition: External biological or cohort signal used beyond the ST data itself.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Use none when no external reference or cohort signal is required for the main method role.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights reference, annotation, cohort, control, and phenotype dependencies that can change method fit.

fields.name: Structural Alignment Need
fields.definition: Whether comparable tissue structure, registration, or a common spatial template is needed for the method's comparative role.
fields.fill_rule: Use none, helpful, required, or unclear. Required means the method's main comparative logic depends on structural matching or registration.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents using registered-pattern methods when structural matching is not defensible.

fields.name: Primary Bias / Validity Caveat
fields.definition: Concise caveat about the strongest scientific-validity risk for this method branch.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert the caveat into a severity score unless later evidence justifies that.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes scientific-critical-thinking concerns explicit for branch-local decision logic.
